purpose: inject a failing terminal revoke and check that the MSI uninstall aborts and keeps the installation usable
packageNote: built before the registry-escaping fix; irrelevant to uninstall ordering
envelope: EZIO-MINI\15119 SID ...-1001 ordinary token; DisableMSI temporarily 0 then restored

injection.method: installed ocxd.exe replaced with an Add-Type stub returning 7

observed.customAction: 23:21:22.641 CustomAction OCX023RevokeTerminalCli returned actual error code 7

defectA.evidence: UnpublishFeatures 23:21:21.408 and RemoveRegistryValues 23:21:21.410 both complete before OCX023RevokeTerminalCli is scheduled at 23:21:22.498
defectA.consequence: rollback restores files but not product registration, leaving a program directory with no uninstall entry; the user cannot repair it from Programs and Features
defectA.contractExpectation: a failing revoke must retain program and registration

defectB.evidence: the retry at 23:21:23 ran RemoveFiles with no ForeignFolder or FileRemove ops and returned 0 while 11 files remained
defectB.consequence: exit 0 alone does not prove removal in this state

correctReadings: the injected failure does abort the uninstall with Error 1722
1603 is the wrapper code for a failed custom action, not a separate cause
openQuestions: whether the earlier successful uninstalls really removed files, since their RemoveFiles may have had nothing to do
how to sequence the revoke ahead of RemoveRegistryValues without breaking current ICE compliance
